trait.name: Contamination (30 ft. Difficult Terrain)
entries: Ground within 30 feet is difficult terrain. Any creature starting its turn there must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution save or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) acid damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the sibriex fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Uses Squirt Bile once, makes two Chain attacks, and uses Warp Creature.

action.name: Chain (Reach 15 ft.)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 2d12 + 7}) force damage.

action.name: Squirt Bile
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 13} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}35 ({@damage 10d6}) acid damage.

action.name: Warp Creature
entries: Up to three creatures within 120 feet must make a {@dc 20} Constitution save or become {@condition poisoned} and gain 1 level of {@condition exhaustion} on each failed repeat.
